title: Juicy Citrusy Algerian Lime Leaves Stir-fry
description: A dairy-free Algerian dish featuring blanched lime leaves for a unique and citrusy flavor profile that's perfect as a hangover cure.
instructions: Blanch the lime leaves in boiling water for about 1 minute. Drain and set aside.
In a separate pan, sauté garlic cloves until fragrant, then add red bell pepper and green chilies (if using), stirring occasionally for another 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes and stir-fry for an additional 5 minutes, seasoning with salt as needed.
Fold in the blanched lime leaves and drizzle with fresh lime juice. Stir gently to combine all ingredients.
Cook over medium heat for about 10-12 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the flavors meld together.
Serve hot or at room temperature as a snack.
